segments.sn12.39:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati … pe …“yañca, bhikkhave, ceteti yañca pakappeti yañca anuseti, ārammaṇametaṃ hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā.
segments.sn12.39:1.4: Tasmiṃ patiṭṭhite viññāṇe virūḷhe nāmarūpassa avakkanti hoti.
segments.sn12.39:1.7: phassapaccayā vedanā … pe … taṇhā … upādānaṃ … bhavo … jāti … jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā sambhavanti.
segments.sn12.39:2.1: “No ce, bhikkhave, ceteti no ce pakappeti, atha ce anuseti, ārammaṇametaṃ hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā.
segments.sn12.39:2.3: Tasmiṃ patiṭṭhite viññāṇe virūḷhe nāmarūpassa avakkanti hoti.
segments.sn12.39:2.4: Nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṃ … pe … evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.
segments.sn12.39:3.1: “Yato ca kho, bhikkhave, no ceva ceteti no ca pakappeti no ca anuseti, ārammaṇametaṃ na hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā.
segments.sn12.39:3.2: Ārammaṇe asati patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa na hoti.
segments.sn12.39:3.3: Tadappatiṭṭhite viññāṇe avirūḷhe nāmarūpassa avakkanti na hoti.
segments.sn12.39:3.4: Nāmarūpanirodhā saḷāyatananirodho … pe … evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotī”ti.

lines: Navame viññāṇanāmarūpānaṃ antare eko sandhi, vedanātaṇhānamantare eko, bhavajātīnamantare ekoti.
Viññāṇanāmarūpānaṃ antare eko sandhīti hetuphalasandhi viññāṇaggahaṇena kammaviññāṇassa gahitattā.
